mechanisms.description: Content-free plugin — 8 hook-based capabilities (identity, E2, compaction, prior-fix, delegation hygiene, feature-registry, session-close, storm-proof-commit). Install via /plugin install aos-core.

identity.description: Work-profile bundle assembled by build_private_bundle.py --profile work. Contains only [SCOPE: work-safe] segments; grep gate enforced before publish. Absent = clean generic persona.

tooling.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that injects curated tool routes at turn-0; work-profile curated routes (AOS/personal routes stripped); webfetch MCP for token-efficient search.
